content: Remain in wonder if you want the mysteries to open up for you. Mysteries never open up to those who go on questioning.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Freedom: The Courage to Be Yourself
story:
From the university lecture halls of Jabalpur to the bustling ashram in Pune, Osho challenged institutional dogmas, religious orthodoxies, and societal hypocrisies. Synthesizing Zen, Sufism, Tantra, and Western therapy, he introduced dynamic meditation techniques designed to shake modern individuals out of obsessive mental chatter into spontaneous, authentic aliveness.

In formulating this reflection, Osho stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of wonder. For Osho, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
